target.statement: ResCAGCN + PUM achieves mR@50 of 20.2 on PredCls (Visual Genome), the headline mean-recall improvement over ResCAGCN's 18.3
target.dataset: Visual Genome (top-150 objects, top-50 predicates split of Xu et al. 2017)

compute.basis: Requires training a Faster R-CNN backbone plus ResCAGCN+PUM on ~100k Visual Genome images (batch size 8, K=N=8 Monte-Carlo samples per pair), which is a multi-GPU-day training run; no code or configs are released, so the full pipeline must be rebuilt from the paper.

blockers: No code release (empty link list); ResCAGCN is only available as a separate concurrent arXiv paper, PUM code absent
Training Faster R-CNN + ResCAGCN + PUM on full Visual Genome is far beyond a few CPU-hours on a laptop
Requires GPU for any realistic training time
title: Probabilistic Modeling of Semantic Ambiguity for Scene Graph Generation
